tools.description: Return a macro guided-reading route from BookStructure by expanding key stops along spine segments. It does not interpret natural language or read Reader or memory state; when the sidecar is absent, it returns explicit unavailable status. Use when: Choose macro reading stops from BookStructure. Do not use for semantic question answering.  Returns a built projection in data, not a generated answer. Collections are paged: data_path identifies a continuation's collection in the original projection and total_items its size. next_calls may include multiple collection branches and search batches. Concept matched_count/truncated still describe bounded candidate recall. Read chosen evidence LIDs with book_text. Missing built capability returns material_unavailable. Copy published_book_ref from book_list and check its available_tools. Costs 1 call on success, including empty results, each continuation page and repeated successful requests; failures cost 0. complete=false means more pages exist; copy needed next_calls name and arguments unchanged. sources gives published_book_ref, start_lid/end_lid, source_range and source_url: cite only evidence actually read, retaining its version and exact range. An empty sources array provides no source citation. usage is the server's post-call balance with charged_units and charged_from; do not infer balance locally. On quota_exhausted stop content retries and report usage.free_resets_at plus top_up_url or top_up_instruction; book_list and mcp_usage remain free.

tools.description: Check this account's server-calculated call balance before planning more reads or after quota_exhausted. Costs 0 calls, even when exhausted. Takes no arguments. Returns usage: free_remaining, paid_remaining, free_resets_at (next Hong Kong month), paid_next_expires_at and call_packs with per-batch expiry and available_units. Free credits are spent first, then valid packs by earliest expiry; all clients share this account's balance. charged_units is 0 and charged_from is null for this query. If both balances are zero, stop content retries and tell the user the reset time and top_up_url, or top_up_instruction when the URL is null. The user arranges purchase; a purchase does not grant material access. No evidence sources or continuation pages are returned.
